en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small railway station with a wooden station building on the left and two trains on parallel tracks. A steam locomotive marked with the number 11 is prominent in the right foreground, while another train with passenger cars stands farther back. Several people are visible on the platform. The lower margin has printed captions, with the left side reading a word that means 'The station' and the right side giving the town name.
